title: Product
description: A product domain of the network's catalog (manifests/products/<domain>.json) that has no service manifest presenting it as a site: a planned product, a sub-domain of a service, a brand domain of a multi-domain service, a closed or moved address. Carries what the network's showcase pages need, copied from the OpenVibe.Sites catalog (plan T11 lane D) so Sites can be deleted. A product whose service manifest has a site block carries the same fields there (registry.service-manifest 1.1.0 site); every catalog domain has exactly one of the two homes. The $defs are shared with that site block.

domain.description: The product's host, unique across the catalog.

icon.description: Icon name of the showcase pages (a Font Awesome name such as fa-utensils).

legalProfile.description: Which legal wording its /terms, /privacy and /dmca use (openvibe-shared/legal), as in a service manifest's site.

kind.description: Absent for a product page. closed: the address was decided against and points elsewhere; moved: the product lives at another address; status: the address shows the network's status. relationships.links say where.

tld.description: The product's short name used everywhere (frame service names, /shared paths), e.g. food for openvibe.food. Not unique: a moved product keeps it on both addresses.

launch.description: What a person still has to do or decide before the product launches. Absent once nothing blocks it.

highlight.description: A featured block on the product page.

vision.description: The product page's vision section (badge, call to action, design preview, steps, choices, features, connections), kept verbatim from the catalog: a presentation payload the showcase renders as it is, not a domain contract.

relationships.description: How the product relates to services, repositories and other pages.

service.description: The service manifest (manifests/services/<id>.json) that serves or will serve this product, when one exists.

plannedRepo.description: The repository planned or used for the product (under github.com/OpenVibers).

noRepo.description: No repository exists for the product yet.

links.description: Where to go instead (a closed, moved or status address).

meanwhile.description: What already works elsewhere on the network while the product is not launched.

statusApi.description: The status API a status page reads.
